name: Meşe Palamudu
scene: An acorn with a patterned cap and one oak leaf.
notes: Portrait oval botanical design; target 44–54 panes. Acorn, cap, stalk and single oak leaf use the warm pair; flowing background uses only teal and blue. Generated with ClaiFace image skill using vitray_fox.png and vitray_poppies.png as style references and acorn-contacts.webp as subject reference. Inspected and regenerated once to replace crowded cap scales with broad alternating curved stripes and restore an opaque white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle fill tonal variation persists; some same-colour neighbours at cap/body and leaf seams may merge during tracing, and closely spaced junctions near the stalk and acorn tip need downstream geometry review. No obvious loose line ends; design sheet only, not audited or published game geometry.
